title: The Wheat Intrinsically Disordered Protein TdRL1 Negatively Regulates the Type One Protein Phosphatase TdPP1.
authors: Amor, Fatma; Bradai, Mariem; Zaidi, Ikram; Amorim-Silva, Vitor; Miled, Nabil; Hanin, Moez; Ebel, Chantal
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小麦无序蛋白TdRL1与磷酸酶TdPP1的互作及抑制机制，结合结构建模揭示无序尾部的结合模式，虽对象为植物蛋白且方法偏结构建模而非AI/MD，但无序蛋白介导的PPI机制建模对本课题有直接启发。
abstract: Type 1 protein phosphatases (PP1s) are crucial in various plant cellular processes. Their function is controlled by regulators known as PP1-interacting proteins (PIPs), often intrinsically disordered, such as Inhibitor 2 (I2), conserved across kingdoms. The durum wheat TdRL1 acts as a positive regulator of plant stress tolerance, presumably by inhibiting PP1 activity. In this work, co-immunoprecipitation and bimolecular fluorescence complementation (BiFC) assays demonstrate that the durum wheat TdPP1 interacts with both TdRL1 and At-I2 in vivo. YFP fluorescence restored after TdRL1-TdPP1 interaction decorated specifically the microtubular network of the tobacco co-infiltrated cells. In vitro phosphatase assays revealed that TdRL1 inhibited the activity of wild-type TdPP1 and two mutant forms (T243M and H135A) in a concentration-dependent manner, showing a novel and potent inhibition mechanism. Structural modeling of the TdPP1-inhibitor complexes suggested that both At-I2 and TdRL1 bind to TdPP1 by wrapping their flexible C-terminal tails around it, blocking access to the active site. Remarkably, the model showed that TdRL1 differs from At-I2 in its interaction with TdPP1 by trapping the phosphatase with its N-terminal tail. These findings provide important insights into the regulatory mechanisms governing the activity of PP1s in plants and highlight the potential for targeted inhibition to modulate plant stress responses.
abstract_zh: 1型蛋白磷酸酶（PP1s）在植物多种细胞过程中至关重要。其功能受称为PP1相互作用蛋白（PIPs）的调节因子控制，这些蛋白通常为内在无序蛋白，如抑制剂2（I2），在生物界中保守存在。硬粒小麦TdRL1作为植物胁迫耐受性的正调控因子，推测通过抑制PP1活性发挥作用。在本研究中，免疫共沉淀和双分子荧光互补（BiFC）实验表明，硬粒小麦TdPP1在体内与TdRL1和At-I2均发生相互作用。TdRL1-TdPP1相互作用后恢复的YFP荧光特异性地装饰于烟草共浸润细胞的微管网络。体外磷酸酶实验揭示，TdRL1以浓度依赖性方式抑制野生型TdPP1及其两种突变体（T243M和H135A）的活性，展示了一种新颖且强效的抑制机制。TdPP1-抑制剂复合物的结构建模表明，At-I2和TdRL1均通过将其柔性C末端尾部缠绕在TdPP1周围来结合，从而阻断活性位点的进入。值得注意的是，模型显示TdRL1与At-I2在TdPP1相互作用上的差异在于，其通过N末端尾部捕获磷酸酶。这些发现为植物中PP1s活性的调控机制提供了重要见解，并强调了靶向抑制在调节植物胁迫响应中的潜力。
